entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate RlmN as a dual-specificity radical-SAM methyltransferase.
RlmN methylates A2503 of 23S rRNA and A37 of tRNA, producing 2-methyladenosine modifications.
RlmN binds one [4Fe–4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine.
Annotated biological processes include rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation; localization is cytoplasm.
EC 2.1.1.192; associated GO terms include 4Fe–4S cluster binding, rRNA/tRNA binding, rRNA adenine-C2 methyltransferase activity, and tRNA adenine-37-C2 methyltransferase activity.
